Assign requests for intervention with explicit rules — {p0}
Attribuer une intervention ne consiste p: Attribution of an intervention is not only about choosing the closest team. The provision, the area actually covered, the declared skills and availability must be taken into account. Automation can propose assignment and report claims that require arbitration.
Décrivez la prestation demandée, l’adres: Describe the service requested, address to be confirmed, time constraints and teams that can handle this type of need. Mandatory criteria must be distinguished from preferences. A file without a complete address must not be assigned to a permanent assignment solely on the basis of the postal code. A common repository helps identify the location without automatically defining your commercial area.
Exemple illustratif : une demande corres: An illustrative example: a claim is a covered benefit, but the municipality remains uncertain. The system prepares a qualification task. After confirmation of the location, he proposes a team available; the manager validates the appointment taking into account the actual schedule and the constraints communicated.
Présentez l’équipe proposée avec les cri: Present the proposed team with the criteria that have been met and the information that remains to be verified. If several teams agree, set a rule of choice that the manager understands. A distance between commune centres should not be transformed into travel time. Confirmation of an appointment requires a check of availability in the tool that is really authoritative for planning.

Une absence de candidat, une adresse amb: An absence of a candidate, an ambiguous address or an unavailable calendar must produce a visible task. Test two competing applications for the same niche and a change of address after proposal. The former assignment must not remain silent. Keep the manager's corrections to understand the inappropriate rules, without allowing the tool to change the skills or areas of intervention of the teams alone.
Une proposition d’affectation ne constit: A proposal for assignment does not constitute confirmation of travel. Skills, access and hours must be maintained by the company. The rules do not guarantee a delay in intervention or a journey; insufficient information requires qualification.
